  expr_tpm_filename: "expr_matrix.tpm.txt"
  sample_meta_filename: "sample_meta.csv"

  sample_reorder_allowed: TRUE

---

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readr)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# Interactive fallback: load params from this RMDs YAML
if (interactive() && !exists("params")) {
  fm <- tryCatch(
    rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(knitr::current_input()),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(fm) && !is.null(fm$params)) {
    params <- fm$params
  }
}
```

# Read and validate input files

```{r params}
# basic checks
if (is.na(params$output_dir_path)) stop("params$output_dir_path can not be missing")

dir.create(params$output_dir_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# shorten gene mapping vars
gene_meta_fn <- params$gene_meta_filename
```

## Confirm files exist

```{r confirm-files}
input_dir <- params$input_dir_path

# Allow either counts or tpm filename to be blank/NULL; require at least one provided and existing
expr_counts_file_path <- NULL
expr_tpm_file_path <- NULL
sample_meta_file_path <- file.path(input_dir, params$sample_meta_filename)

if (!dir.exists(input_dir)) stop("Input directory does not exist: ", input_dir)

if (!is.null(params$expr_counts_filename) && !is.na(params$expr_counts_filename) && params$expr_counts_filename != "") {
  expr_counts_file_path <- file.path(input_dir, params$expr_counts_filename)
  if (!file.exists(expr_counts_file_path)) stop("Expression counts file does not exist: ", expr_counts_file_path)
}

if (!is.null(params$expr_tpm_filename) && !is.na(params$expr_tpm_filename) && params$expr_tpm_filename != "") {
  expr_tpm_file_path <- file.path(input_dir, params$expr_tpm_filename)
  if (!file.exists(expr_tpm_file_path)) stop("Expression TPM file does not exist: ", expr_tpm_file_path)
}

if (!file.exists(sample_meta_file_path)) stop("Samples file does not exist: ", sample_meta_file_path)
if (!file.exists(file.path(input_dir, gene_meta_fn))) stop("Gene metadata file not found: ", gene_meta_fn)

if (is.null(expr_counts_file_path) && is.null(expr_tpm_file_path)) stop("At least one of params$expr_counts_filename or params$expr_tpm_filename must be provided and exist.")
```

## Sample metadata

```{r samples}
# read samples
samples <- read.csv(sample_meta_file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!(params$sample_primary_key %in% colnames(samples))) stop("Sample primary key column not found in samples file: ", params$sample_primary_key)

# drop empty/NA columns
samples <- samples %>% dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x) | .x %in% c("\"NA\"", ""))))
```

## Read expression matrices

```{r read-expr}
expr_counts <- NULL
expr_tpm <- NULL

if (!is.null(expr_counts_file_path)) {
  expr_counts <- read.delim(expr_counts_file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(expr_counts)[1] <- "gene_id"
}

if (!is.null(expr_tpm_file_path)) {
  expr_tpm <- read.delim(expr_tpm_file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(expr_tpm)[1] <- "gene_id"
}

if (!is.null(expr_counts) && !is.null(expr_tpm)) {
  if (!all(colnames(expr_counts) == colnames(expr_tpm))) stop("Column names (samples) of expr_counts and expr_tpm do not match")
}
```

## Gene metadata

```{r feat}
gene_meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, gene_meta_fn), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Rename first column to unique_gene_id
colnames(gene_meta)[1] <- "unique_gene_id"

# Ensure we have unique_gene_id column for downstream compatibility
gene_meta <- gene_meta %>% 
  dplyr::select(unique_gene_id, everything())

# check mapping coverage
if (!is.null(expr_counts)) {
  num_missing_gene_ids_from_counts <- sum(!gene_meta$unique_gene_id %in% expr_counts$gene_id)
  if (num_missing_gene_ids_from_counts / nrow(gene_meta) > 0.2) message("Warning: More than 20% of gene ids in metadata are missing from expr_counts")
}

if (!is.null(expr_tpm)) {
  num_missing_gene_ids_from_tpm <- sum(!gene_meta$unique_gene_id %in% expr_tpm$gene_id)
  if (num_missing_gene_ids_from_tpm / nrow(gene_meta) > 0.2) message("Warning: More than 20% of gene ids in metadata are missing from expr_tpm")
}
```

## Align expression with samples and genes

```{r align}
# Filter expression to only include genes present in gene_meta
expr_tpm_final <- NULL
expr_counts_final <- NULL

if (!is.null(expr_tpm)) {
  expr_tpm_final <- expr_tpm %>% dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% gene_meta$unique_gene_id)
  rownames(expr_tpm_final) <- expr_tpm_final$gene_id
  expr_tpm_final <- expr_tpm_final %>% dplyr::select(-gene_id)
}

if (!is.null(expr_counts)) {
  expr_counts_final <- expr_counts %>% dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% gene_meta$unique_gene_id)
  rownames(expr_counts_final) <- expr_counts_final$gene_id
  expr_counts_final <- expr_counts_final %>% dplyr::select(-gene_id)
}

# Choose a primary expression matrix (TPM preferred) for sample/gene ordering decisions
expr_primary_final <- if (!is.null(expr_tpm_final)) expr_tpm_final else expr_counts_final

# Ensure the primary expression matrix exists and has samples
if (is.null(expr_primary_final) || ncol(expr_primary_final) == 0) stop("Expression matrix is missing or has no samples.")

# align row data (gene_meta) to match the primary expression matrix
if (params$feature_reorder_allowed) {
  gene_meta <- gene_meta[match(rownames(expr_primary_final), gene_meta$unique_gene_id), ]
} else {
  if (!all(gene_meta$unique_gene_id == rownames(expr_primary_final))) {
    stop("Gene metadata and expression matrices do not contain the same genes in the same order. Try setting params$feature_reorder_allowed=TRUE.")
  }
}
```

## Build SummarizedExperiment and save

```{r build-se}
# prepare rowData and colData
row_df <- gene_meta
rownames(row_df) <- if (!is.null(row_df$unique_gene_id)) row_df$unique_gene_id else NULL

col_df <- samples
rownames(col_df) <- samples[[params$sample_primary_key]]

# Validation: Check if sample metadata and expression matrices align
sample_names_meta <- rownames(col_df)
sample_names_expr <- colnames(expr_primary_final)

if (!all(sample_names_meta == sample_names_expr)) {
  if (all(sort(sample_names_meta) == sort(sample_names_expr))) {
    if (params$sample_reorder_allowed) {
      message("Reordering expression matrices to match sample metadata order.")
      if (!is.null(expr_tpm_final)) expr_tpm_final <- expr_tpm_final[, sample_names_meta, drop = FALSE]
      if (!is.null(expr_counts_final)) expr_counts_final <- expr_counts_final[, sample_names_meta, drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      stop("Sample metadata and expression matrix are not in the same order. Set params$sample_reorder_allowed=TRUE to fix.")
    }
  } else {
    stop("Sample metadata and expression matrix do not contain the same set of samples.")
  }
}

assays_list <- list()
if (!is.null(expr_tpm_final)) assays_list$tpm <- as.matrix(expr_tpm_final)
if (!is.null(expr_counts_final)) assays_list$counts <- as.matrix(expr_counts_final)

se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(assays = assays_list, rowData = row_df, colData = col_df)

save(se, file = file.path(params$output_dir_path, "expr_SE.Rdata"))

message("Saved SummarizedExperiment to: ", file.path(params$output_dir_path, "expr_SE.Rdata"))
```

# Done

Files written to `r params$output_dir_path`:

- `r file.path(params$output_dir_path, "expr_SE.Rdata")`
